D02.observations: Left-flank damage reading: skirt loss, multiple scorched penetrations, raised driver and rear roof lids with dark apertures; right flank comparatively clean. Barrel carries continuous thin near-black longitudinal strokes; launcher perimeter is a single clean thin outline, no dash trains or doubled borders. Native-256 silhouette remains clearly a Bradley.
minorNonBlockingNotes: Raised rear roof lid reads as a flat, near-uniform brown plate with little surface treatment; existing geometry/material unchanged in r10 and acceptable for grounded-miniature style.

D03.observations: Frontal/engine-deck damage reading: displaced/blasted grille, scorched glacis, turret-roof scorch near commander station; flanks largely intact. Clearly distinct from D02 (front vs left-flank damage). Barrel and launcher lines thin, continuous and near-black; launcher end tubes and perimeter crisp.

W02.observations: Burned wreck: dropped rear ramp exposing dark interior, thrown/lying track strip, splayed side panels, raised roof lid, charred surface with rust highlights. Turret and launcher retained. Line work present and continuous; contrast against charred surfaces is intentionally low but perimeter and barrel strokes remain legible at 1024.
minorNonBlockingNotes: At native 256 the near-black lines on the charred launcher/barrel are barely perceptible; consistent with the 'very thin' request and with wreck value grouping.

W03.observations: Burned wreck with launcher torn askew off its mount, removed hatch aperture, lost road wheel/debris on ground, rear intact. Clearly distinct from W02 (rear ramp/track loss) at native 256 and in all nine views. Barrel strokes continuous; tilted launcher perimeter clean.
minorNonBlockingNotes: Faint short dark marks at launcher internal panel seams are pre-existing texture detail, not the added line geometry; not read as r9-style dotted aliasing.

conditionDistinction: All four are mutually distinguishable and distinct from preserved D01/W01 in kind: D02 left-flank penetrations/skirt loss; D03 frontal/engine-deck blast; W02 rear ramp drop, thrown track, open interior; W03 launcher torn off mount, missing hatch/wheel. Damaged recipes keep tan finish; wreck recipes read burned.
